display_title: Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者

reviews.text: 难度比较亲民,比较易上手,希望后面多一些玩法,多一些养成,设置多难度,还有通关奖励.

目前音画表现欠缺打磨，但奈何价格亲民，妹子好看，期待后续更新 游戏当前难度并不高，同类玩家很好上手，局外升级前期也非常友好，即便不点也能通关 特色： 1：除去【被动】【武器】外，拥有独特且丰富的【魔法】系统 （可惜【神器】当前版本较为弱势，且没有专属强化项目，期待后续完善） 2：【杀怪直接涨经验】，怪物掉落的法力水晶可以囤积，实际节奏非常快 （相对的，如果走慢热性流派，为了建立雪球优势，前期也会和其他流派一样同质化） 3：既可以开启【自动】当做传统【类幸存者】游玩，也可以体验特色【手操】玩法 4：拥有【同类型全部禁用】系统，适合熟练度高，目的性强，或是想要挑战自身的玩家在合适时机选取 5：【被动】之间也有【进阶组合】，实际上能玩出很多花样（如利用【位移】/【百磁王】拾取全屏秒杀的【圣剑】，利用【强制掉落】触发【战场死神】让【范围魔法】覆盖全屏，甚至还有【生存流】）不过在整体流程。或者说引导，理解方面还需优化 目前难度较为简单，也无法变更，10分钟的单局时长让人有些意犹未尽 希望能早些更新更多难度，更多有趣的地图和挑战之类的吧 闲话： 在【类幸存者】这块算比较有新意，大胆的了 【法力值】的设计让这类相对【简单】的游戏类型多了一个【运营点】 新人觉得手忙脚乱，可以直接开启【自动】，等到熟悉以后便可以尝试【更具有挑战性，上限更高的手操玩法】 不过，本身就是讲究快感的游戏类型，在增加门槛与趣闻性之间希望能做好平衡，让更多人愿意尝试手操，并且获得快乐 此外，看作者自己的研发记录，很明显是知道大部分幸存者游戏的痛点的，希望能越做越好吧 ————————————————————————————————————————— 其实只是想鼓励一下做美少女内容的幸存者游戏而已
伤害很低，同类型游戏能没指引基本难度下可以通关 这里藏魔法太深了 重玩了3次感觉也没解锁什么强力技能.....3-4次的斧头才20 伤害 只能说支持一波而已 加油吧！

[h1]写在前面：[/h1]本篇评测基于本人自身游戏体验，仅供萌新参考，助力诸位萌新可以更快速适应并上手本游戏，最终解释权归[spoiler]老登[/spoiler]游戏作者所有。 [h1]1.职业流派选择：[/h1] 初次接触一项全新游戏，尤其是这种刷刷刷怪类型，选择一种强势职业流派可以大幅提升游玩体验。当前游戏有魔法（手动攻击）、神器（自动攻击）两种流派，同时对应开局可选的两名角色，艾希（魔法）莎莉（神器）。魔法流派通过消耗法力值释放技能；神器流派通过消耗法力上限（没看错，是法力上限）装配神器，在游戏中可以装配六个技能或神器，人物每升一级可以选择技能/神器/天赋强化。 魔法在前期缺乏AOE技能，生存能力羸弱，手动操作略有繁琐[spoiler]（费手费键盘）[/spoiler]，在能力未强化时不建议萌新选择。而升级能力需要小钱钱，[spoiler]（老登作者扣扣搜搜也不多爆点金币）[/spoiler]唯有神器才能担当刷钱重任。神器可以自动攻击敌人，并不需要多余操作，只需选择合适的神器便可无所畏惧（当然走位还是必不可少的） 一句话总结：魔法前期苟延残喘，中期挺直腰杆，后期大杀四方；神器全程所向披靡。（其他具体设定在游戏图鉴教程中有详细解答，本评测不再赘述） 2.局内体验： 魔法方面：魔法流派前期太容易死了，千万别选，先用神器刷钱把能力提上来再用魔法爽。 神器方面：远程推荐选择弓、弩；近战推荐选择范围型神器，如长剑、斧（长剑更好一些，覆盖范围比斧大）；铠甲和盾牌也是强力神器，前者可以将伤害返还给怪物（反甲），后者可以通过撞击对怪物造成伤害，配合抖盾术（在移动过程中疯狂摆头可覆盖更广范围并打出更高伤害）可称一绝；当然少不了清屏神器——胜利誓约之剑，只要拔出此剑，不管是多如牛毛的小怪，还是卡身位的精英BOSS，统统秒杀，让你体会瞬间[strike]通畅[/strike]的快感[spoiler]（有些神器搭配技能天赋会升级成更强力的神器，提前去图鉴了解一下，谴责啥也不说的老登作者）[/spoiler] 技能天赋方面：按需选取即可（不过这种游戏AOE技能和辅助天赋更吃香一些） [h3]特别注意：[/h3]不要听[spoiler]老登[/spoiler]作者的话，在第一次升级时点击“禁用全部”，会浪费一次选择机会（后期可以点，保证稳定需求） 3.其他事项： 关于涩涩：某摇确实有，但实际表现嘛，大哥怪都挠脸上来了还有心情看这个？CG[spoiler]（PPT）[/spoiler]挺好看的嗯 关于价格：原价11打折8.8，一杯奶茶钱，确实不贵 关于配置：无需太高，市面售卖的电脑均可畅玩 关于内容：一局十分钟，适合消磨时光，时间很快就在刷刷刷中度过 关于未来：这个大概要去问作者吧（笑）不过未来如果加入新地图，新角色，新剧情，新玩法，新CG[spoiler]（战败CG！！！我要看战败CG！！！）[/spoiler][strike]本游戏一定可以蒸蒸日上的呦（捧读）[/strike] 以上就是本人的一点拙见，可能有些语无伦次，实属抱歉，希望能给各位萌新带来帮助~

《伊泰恩：魔法幸存者》一款类幸存者的肉鸽类型的俯视角竞技场升级生存游戏，初次体验到被精英怪和boss男上加男后艾希满级后我有了以下攻略 新手期在能力强化不足图鉴魔法不全的情况下可以靠着神器【胜利誓约】来度过，前期优先点出二级【胜利誓约】；【自动愈合】【强健体魄】等等加血加防规避伤害类型的都可；能方面则是可用【冰霜护甲】【冰霜冲刺】【风行步伐】【疾风冲刺】等技能来规避怪物，利用速度优势来捡剑清怪坚持十分钟即可通关 当然如果想体验站着不动自动打怪的爽感则可以用接下来的这套攻落 技能【跟踪龙卷】一项伤害很高清怪很快的技能，搭配天赋【风系加强】【风系覆盖】【风系耐用】【风系神射】【风系节能】【穿透进阶】【延时】【冷却平衡】冷却时间减少魔法持续时间增加上来后就可以开始挂机了，但要注意8分钟后会出现boss那时候就需要动一动了。 好了，攻略就到此为止，就目前而言游戏是个好游戏，各种职业技能天赋流派之间的串联可以爽完几十个小时，但是通常都在想玩的流派职业通关几次后就没有再那么想继续游玩下去的感觉了，期待这之后作者能更新难度不同的关卡，无尽模式等等内容。
还不错，继续玩一下，很多技能还没有摸熟悉 ，不喜欢动鼠标的有自动模式挺好
先支持下作者吧，毕竟这价格确实不贵，新图新奈子赶紧上上来

Needs more content, specifically more challenges/stages. The game currently has 3 characters and 1 stage. I'm really enjoying the mana resource management, but there isn't too much mana manipulation going on. It should be expanded on. I would not recommend the game in it's current state, but it shows great potential and I'm willing to put this on the backburner while the Dev continues to work on it.
游戏已经通关许多次了，玩法感觉有限，继续加油吧。

An interesting take on the genre, with mana based spells and mana reservation based artifacts. I can see the what the author is trying to do, however I'm afraid as it is implemented right now the mana mechanic is too punishing to be fun. Even with mid level mana/mana regen/mana cost upgrades taking like even 3 spells out of 5 drains your mana too fast for autocast. I play survivor games to watch the screen get filled with projectiles, if the game design goes against this then it's not for me. Overall it gets a recommendation from me, playing with an artifact-only character is kinda like playing a normal survivors game. If only for the price. And you skip out on half the mechanics. If it was more than this price I'd have to recommend against it, as the mana system penalizes you for experimenting with spells in the survivors fashion. It's closer to a roguelike with all auto attacks and watching the cooldowns for all 5 spells and managing your mana. So if you like that kind of gameplay go for it. ==EDIT== After I played some more I found that my build choice of maxing cooldown reduction and going with 5 autocast spells wasn't exactly optimal. 3 autocast spells with mana regen is perfectly fine with some artifacts sprinkled in. Also it has some nice images to unlock, that alone gets 2 thumbs up. TL;DR; Game is fine, my problem was a skill issue.

[h1][b]回蓝呢！我的回蓝呢？[/b][/h1] [b]*抢先体验版（EA）*[/b]『一般推荐』《Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者》是由TEMagicGames制作并发行的一款俯视角的竞技场射击生存类roguelite游戏（既类吸血鬼幸存者）。玩家将要操控可操纵不同元素力的角色，通过魔法或神器消灭成接连而来的敌人们，坚持撑过整整十分钟后即可通关。 本作目前共有两种模式和六个难度，无双模式下是让玩家上手并熟悉游戏的玩法，而普通模式就是正常的标准模式。目前能玩到的最高难度并不难，笔者用了不到3个小时就通关全部关卡，稍微精通了一位角色以及她的技能便能很轻松的通关。 [h1]游戏 7/10 只要不缺蓝，那就是稳赢的局[/h1] 本作的玩法和常规的类吸血鬼幸存者大差不差，玩家初始需要选择一位少女进行战斗，目前共有4位可选择的少女，分别是黑长直胶衣少女“艾希”、手持镰刀的粉毛修女“莎莉”、黄毛医生“劳拉”和有点小酷的红毛“安吉拉”。她们可使用的魔法属性是不一样的，每个人都有独特的数值、被动和主动技能。随着角色使用的次数增多，其灵魂共鸣等级也会随之增加，解锁更多强力的主动技能。每到特定时间就会刷新小型BOSS，攻击很高，碰撞箱很怪，但是会掉落技能。而最终的大型BOSS，击杀后则会掉落塔罗牌般的命运加护，但是都要结束了才出这个，总体的节奏有点怪。 而在局内中，玩家可以通过角色的升级，从而选取天赋（被动）、魔法（主动）和神器（自动）。本作除了血条之外，还有一个蓝条，魔法和神器都需要蓝条。每次发动魔法都会消耗蓝量，而神器会直接减少蓝条的最大上限。所有能造成有效攻击的技能都极其依赖于蓝条，没有了蓝条，魔法一个都用不出来（悲），前几局最常见的死法就是蓝条不够。所以说要想玩的舒服，在前期拿到这唯一一个回复蓝条的天赋是最重要的。当然，由于全程给的技能都是随机的，也有可能出现在游戏的极后期才拿到，刷新次数也用完了，那就可以靠着自己精湛的手法，硬拿神器和少量魔法，靠着免伤被动卖血硬过。 游戏局内获取的金币，可在局外用于升级科技树强化能力或是解锁新的人物。在我玩的这几局中，冰系的技能用着是最舒服的，绑定了一个持续冻结的效果；而火系的技能用着较大的AOE，甚至点满了还能实现挂机摆烂。不过其他的技能就相对比较普通了，前期也尽量选择有旋转体的技能，或者以自身为中心释放的技能，再结合减少释放CD和提高伤害的被动，面对再多的怪海也是随便杀（确信）。 总的来说，游戏目前的质量还是可以的，设置里还可以选择自动施法，很适合懒狗玩家。上手容易难度也不会很高，技能成型之后就是挂机了，期待后续的更新。 [h1]其他 6/10 RSQ搞多点！！！[/h1] 每次胜利之后，所使用的角色都会解锁数枚软涩涩的CG，画的蛮不错的，就是些福利图，量自然是比较少的。同样可惜的是目前内容还是比较少的，怪物地图什么的玩一次后续的内容就都是这些了，后续难度变化差异好像也不大，大BOSS也只有一只。人物立绘是比较好看（涩）的那种，局内人物的像素小人很可爱，但是技能释放的呈现就显得比较敷衍。音乐比较单调，角色们也没有配音什么的。 [h1]结语[/h1] 少见的二次元风格类幸存者，目前的内容比较少。建议等游戏正式上线后，再决定是否入手。 [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]
真的不推荐，恶心的不行。要从一堆sb技能里roll到你要的那个真的，有点难。精英怪的碰撞体积比它那个狗贴图大很多。。。两个啥比玩意贴住你移速慢的话跑都跑不掉，给我恶心坏了。。。

和其他类似游戏有一定差异化，但是流程冗长的缺点还是一样，这种小游戏一把十几分钟？缩短流程或者给个加速按钮说不定好一点

价格是挺便宜的，但是小问题真的太多了。 首先是平衡性真的太差劲了，前期太难后期太简单。八个天赋六个神器六个魔法，没有伪随机保底导致一大堆没用的垃圾随机出来占你的格子，升级奖励实在是太难选了。子弹流派耗蓝高伤害丢人，穿透流派也不怎么样。其他的都是随便打。位移技能的手感也是垃圾的不行，玩了一局叠护甲泥头车结果这个位移技能的手感给我恶心到了。 只有软色情，没有实际内容。目前还在持续更新中，各种技能不停的删改，建议等版本稳定了再玩。 ~ 回复开发者的话：前期难，后期爽是类幸存者的特色。但这个游戏前期太难后期太简单已经脱离了这个特色的范畴，明显是数值填写有问题。至于说的伪随机的问题，一个没什么用的不符合当前流派的垃圾魔法连续五六次升级占我同一个选择栏，这种情况已经完全不是所谓的"技能池太大，有加权"这种借口了。 至于子弹流最强这种笑话，我只能说我已经把所以输出技能拉满了，我看不到上限在哪。当然仅限于我玩的那个版本，之后版本我看到了作者对子弹流做了很多加强。（你自己说子弹流是最强的，然后连续好几个版本加强子弹流，笑） 至于软色情没有实际内容这一点，我从一开始就在简介上看到了。我只是在差评里随便提了一嘴而已，目的是让之后的玩家清楚这一点。当然你也可以说我嘴硬，但是我的评测风格就是如此，我从其他游戏的评测里也是这样说，信不信随你。 ~ 我还是保持我之前的观点，至少在版本完善之前，我并不推荐购买这个游戏。

Does so many things right, but so many things are truly odd. Result doesn't add up to a net positive for me. Gave it a chance but in summary, too much of the game revolves around mana management. It's overly complicated in this regard for a rogue-lite. Example: I love having choice and control, but even POE doesn't allow players to over commit to selecting skills with more mana reservation than they have. If you do, you can easily see before it's too late and can disable the skill without being punished. You also have Path of Building to test your choices before making them. A small indie doesn't have the luxury of external apps like PoB to help players making the right decisions - that's why it doesn't work here. The good things it does are offering a lot of control over aim, control itself and skill variety. It goes a little overboard though - the dev even tells you which skills impact performance. I thought this was kind of funny considering it's all retro/pixel-styled. I also bought a good gaming PC to not have to worry about my hardware limiting or influencing what/how I play. I play these for quick, pickup-and-play enjoyment, not for theory crafting complex builds and planning resources. Otherwise I'd be playing POE. A lot of people like the game, just wasn't what I was looking for.

What a trully wonderfull game! There are many different settings, so you can cater to your preferences, which I really like. There aren't really many survivors games with this many settings. There is a lot of abilities, combinations, resource management. The grind for money(for upgrades) is not big. It's a passionate project from a solo dev, and you can see how much love he put into it, with all the explanations of the abilities, and having both accessible settings and modes for "hardcore" players. And the price is very good, so for me it's 100% worth. Last but not least, the girls are hot, and have jiggling boobas, Very nice!

I'm giving this game a Not Recommended, but I am not happy about it and I hope I can change it to a Recommended sooner or later. I played nearly two hours of the game and I've been waffling about whether to refund it or not, because on one hand it has a lot of potential to be a really cool garliclike with good strategic depth, but on the other... it needs a LOT of work, and there are more ways it could go wrong than it could go right, depending on the dev's intentions, skill, and dedication. That said, I decided not to refund it, because I think the potential there outweighs the risk. If you like this genre and you're ok with buying a game that absolutely needs work and may not pan out, but brings in original mechanics and ideas that are genuinely exciting, then go for it, this game is worth a try. If you want a game that is already fun as is, then as of this review (Aug 2024) you should probably hold off until it becomes clear whether it will materialize.

I generally don't write reviews, but this game deserves it. Since this game has just recently gotten out of "Early Access", it is the best time to write one. I have played it for a while and I have all the Achievements, so I have a good idea of all it offers. I like "Survivors"-like games. I bought this game because it was pretty cheap when it was in Early Access. Also, it has nice anime-style girls (I particularly don't like characters with too much emphasis on their breasts, but it isn't something that bothered me too much while playing). First of all, something I have to mention is that it isn't a "Hentai" game. People may be confused with the "Nudity" tag, but the game doesn't show sex or anything explicit (there is nudity, but nothing "important" is shown, like most ecchi anime). So it is a "safe" game (Korean/Chinese gacha games are "worst" in this aspect). About the game itself, at first, it may look like the hundreds of other cheap "survivors" clones in the Store. But it is varied in the mechanics and the play styles you can choose to tackle each run. I am not going to mention the game's features, the store page does a good job of mentioning them. Sadly, it has a big problem that may deter a lot of players, the early game does a bad job showing the complexity and variety of the game. There are 21 Difficulty levels (0 to 20). You start at 0. Each time you complete a run with the highest level, the next one unlocks. You can easily beat all the early levels with an Artifact called "Victory Vow". It kills all the enemies on the map (including Bosses and Elites) when you touch it and it flies to another place afterward. You keep repeating the process until you win. Starting from level 15, Bosses/Elites are immune to this tactic, forcing you to try different things (this is a good thing). Each run, at minimum, takes 10 minutes (not including time stop and the level-up screen). That means 150 minutes (two hours and a half), more than the time to refund a game. Not enough time to see all the best the game has to offer or to be forced to try different "builds" for your characters. Yes, nobody is forcing you to use "Victory Vow", but it is the most efficient/fast way to beat the early levels while unlocking the Spells/Talents/Artifacts/Characters that will make your experience a lot more varied and fun. The bad thing is that, even without "Victory Vow", there is a simple Spell/Artifact combination (I am not going to mention it) that makes beating even lv20 "Prison" in Advanced Mode simple (with proper Talents). Once you have unlocked most of the things, the game gets a lot more fun. So I am going to explain what I find "fun" about this game. There is a Challenge Mode in this game that forces you to try different builds. While some could still be easily completed with a standard build, others require you to get a proper combination of Spell/Talents/Artifacts/Fate Gifts in order to win. In a certain way, you could say that it is like a puzzle. The game is at its best when it takes you away from your comfort zone. Another mode is Boss Rush. It isn't hard if you just want to beat it, but to get the under 2-minute Achievement is a test of knowledge. I am not going to mention the solution, but it was totally satisfying discovering it. It took me a lot of tries and using combinations I never bothered using before. But it was fun playing around and slowly getting closer to the 2-minute mark. The "hardest" mode is Endless. There is an Achievement to survive for 60 minutes. I didn't particularly find it that hard, because there was a similar Challenge. The problem is that it is not a simple survival mode, but it gets harder every 10 minutes (like making Barriers useless, Armor taking more damage, and reducing your Max HP). This is another achievement that requires your knowledge of the game. Every skill counts and something that doesn't synergize will make you build fail and lose before the 60-minute mark. To finish, I am going to briefly list some PROS and CONS. [h2]PROS:[/h2] - A lot of gameplay settings to make your experience more accessible or simpler. - A complete Encyclopedia with everything about the game (Spells, Talents, Fate Gift, Tutorials...). - They may not look professional, but I liked the character designs (at least compared to the cheap-looking AI ones in other similar games) - A great number of combinations and synergies. It feels nice discovering useful ones. Even weak Artifacts can be pretty strong with a proper build. [h2]CONS:[/h2] - It isn't an optimized game. When there are a lot of things on the screen, the FPS drops a lot. At least, the game warns you about it and recommends ways to prevent/minimize them. - The Standard and Advanced Modes are "boring". They get better once you get to level 15. But once you "solve" level 20, there is no reason to play them again, other than trying different builds or getting money. - I wouldn't say the game looks bad, but the UI makes it look a bit "cheap" (it is a low-budget game after all). It doesn't detract from the overall game. - The music isn't memorable. Not bad, but if you play over and over, it tends to get repetitive. Most of the time, I was playing videos on my phone while playing. - Other than the bits of information in the characters' profiles, there isn't a story in the game. - I mentioned that the number of Spell/Artifacts/etc... is one of the good features. But some of them felt too weak, situational or there were stronger options. It is fun trying different builds, but it is likely you will use just a few. Other than to get Achievements, you really don't need to experiment too much. To conclude, "Etaine: Magic Survivor" may be another "cheap" Survivor-like game. But, compared to most, you can see that the developer put some effort into it and not just a quick cash grab. I will probably buy the next game in the "Etaine" series.

《Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者》是一款结合了魔法、生存和Roguelike元素的动作游戏，玩家在游戏中扮演一名魔法师，通过使用各种魔法和神器来对抗成群的敌人，努力在充满危险的世界中生存下来。 游戏包含120种魔法，分为8种属性，每种属性各有15种魔法。玩家可以根据自己的喜好和战斗风格选择不同的魔法组合，形成独特的流派。游戏中有78件神器，分为4种稀有度，从普通到传说级。神器不仅可以增强角色的能力，还能提供特殊效果，但激活神器需要占用法力上限，因此玩家需要合理管理法力。游戏提供了151种天赋，这些天赋可以增强角色的属性或提供额外的游戏机制效果。游戏中有22张塔罗牌，每张塔罗牌都提供独特的特殊效果，但通常只能通过击杀BOSS获得。 总体而言，《Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者》是一款适合喜欢魔法和Roguelike游戏的玩家的作品。

Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者, developed and published by TEMagicGames, is a survival roguelite that builds on the increasingly popular formula of arena-based combat and incremental power growth, while adding its own layer of mechanical involvement through more active spell usage and resource management. The game places players in control of a magic user thrown into hostile environments filled with relentless waves of enemies, where survival depends on both quick decision-making and long-term build planning. It is a familiar setup, but one that proves engaging thanks to its constant sense of progression and the sheer satisfaction of gradually turning a fragile character into a destructive force. The core gameplay loop revolves around movement, combat, and continuous upgrades. Players navigate open arenas while enemies swarm from all directions, collecting experience and resources that allow them to level up and enhance their abilities. Unlike some titles in the genre that rely heavily on automated attacks, Etaine leans more into manual control, giving players greater influence over how and when abilities are used. This adds a layer of engagement that requires attention and timing, especially when managing multiple spells or reacting to sudden bursts of enemy pressure. Each level-up presents a choice between different upgrades, encouraging players to think about how their decisions will shape the overall build. One of the game’s most notable strengths lies in its variety of spells, items, and upgrades. There is a strong emphasis on experimentation, with numerous combinations that can lead to vastly different playstyles. Some builds focus on overwhelming damage output, filling the screen with projectiles, while others prioritize survival through defensive mechanics or resource efficiency. The inclusion of a mana system further deepens the gameplay, as players must balance their ability usage with available resources, preventing the experience from becoming entirely passive. This system encourages a more thoughtful approach, especially in longer runs where resource management becomes increasingly important. Replayability is supported by multiple modes and escalating difficulty levels. As players progress, they unlock new challenges that push them to refine their strategies and adapt to tougher conditions. These higher difficulty tiers introduce more aggressive enemy behavior and require a deeper understanding of the game’s systems. However, this is also where balance issues begin to surface. Certain builds and upgrade paths tend to be significantly more effective than others, which can limit experimentation once optimal strategies are discovered. While the variety is there, not all options feel equally viable, which can reduce the sense of freedom over time. Visually, the game presents a mix of strengths and inconsistencies. Character designs, particularly the player-controlled mages, are detailed and stylized, standing out clearly against the battlefield. However, enemy designs and environments are more simplistic, creating a contrast that can make the overall presentation feel uneven. During intense moments, the screen fills with effects and projectiles, creating a chaotic but visually engaging spectacle. While this can be exciting, it can also become overwhelming, making it harder to track important elements during late-game scenarios. The pacing is initially one of the game’s strongest aspects. Early runs are fast and rewarding, with frequent upgrades and a clear sense of progression that keeps players engaged. The cycle of starting a run, building power, and pushing further into the challenge creates a compelling loop that encourages repeated play. Over time, however, the repetition becomes more noticeable. While different builds offer some variation, the underlying structure remains largely unchanged, and extended sessions can begin to feel predictable once players become familiar with the mechanics. Narratively, the game takes a minimal approach. There is little emphasis on story or character development, with the focus placed almost entirely on gameplay systems and replayability. This design choice aligns with the genre, but it also means that players looking for a deeper narrative experience may find the game lacking in that area. The world exists primarily as a backdrop for the action rather than a fully realized setting. Overall, Etaine: Magic Survivor is a solid entry in the survival roguelite genre that offers an engaging mix of active combat and build experimentation. It succeeds in creating a satisfying progression loop and provides enough variety to keep players interested across multiple runs. However, its balance issues, repetitive structure, and uneven presentation prevent it from reaching a higher level of refinement. It is an enjoyable experience for fans of the genre, particularly those who appreciate a more hands-on approach to combat, but it stops short of standing out as a top-tier example. Rating: 7/10
